case_number: WRIT PETITION (CRIMINAL) NO. 113 OF 2016, WITH SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION @ (DIARY) NO. 34629 OF 2017

parties.respondent: The State Of Uttar Pradesh & Govt. Of U.P.

summary: Constitutional Bench reference on free speech limitations; Articles 19(2) restrictions deemed exhaustive; no extension of free speech restrictions via other fundamental rights; fundamental rights enforceable solely against State or instrumentalities; State duty to protect life/liberty against private threats under Article 21 confirmed; ministerial statements not vicariously attributable to government per principle of collective responsibility; ministerial speech violating constitutional rights actionable as constitutional tort; upheld State's obligation to enforce morality and lawfulness among ministers.
legal_provisions_cited: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (POCSO)
final_judgment: Constitutional queries answered; writ petition and special leave petition disposed with directions for State to enforce ministerial responsibility.
